rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a precious or semi-precious gemstone.

example.jyutping: ni1 lap1 bou2 sek6 hou2 hon2 jau5

rows.note: Use this for a wearable jewellery item rather than for the stone itself.

example.english: This jewel was left to me by my mother.
example.traditional: 呢件首飾係我阿媽留畀我嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 sau2 sik1 hai6 ngo5 aa3 maa1 lau4 bei2 ngo5 ge3

rows.note: Use this for a person or thing regarded as especially precious or valued.

example.english: You are my most precious jewel.
example.jyutping: nei5 hai6 ngo5 zeoi3 zan1 sik1 ge3 bou2 bui3
